:::{#def-cv-estimate-indexed}
#### Cross-validation estimate of a named procedure

Let a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$, indexed by $\obsidx$,
be divided into [folds](#def-folds) $\fold{1}, \ldots, \fold{\nfolds}$.
The **cross-validation estimate of procedure** $\fitproc$ on $\trainset$,
$\cvestof{\nfolds}{\fitproc}\paren{\trainset}$,
is the [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate)
computed with [fold-out rules](#def-fold-out-rule) that $\fitproc$ produces from $\trainset$:

$$
\cvestof{\nfolds}{\fitproc}\paren{\trainset} \eqdef \frac{1}{\nobs} \sum_{\iobs \in \obsidx}
\sqf{\fitprocf{\paren{(\predvar_{\iobs'}, \outvar_{\iobs'})}_{\iobs' \in \obsidx \setminus \fold{\foldof{\iobs}}}}\paren{\predvar_{\iobs}} - \outvar_{\iobs}}.
$$ {#eq-cv-estimate-indexed}

:::
